n_b = input().split()
n = int(n_b[0])
b = int(n_b[1])
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
diff_array = []
diff_count = 0
even_count = 1 if a[0] % 2 == 0 else 0
odd_count = 1 if a[0] % 2 == 1 else 0

for i in range(1, n):
    if even_count == odd_count:
        diff_array.append(abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]))
        diff_count += 1
    if a[i] % 2 == 0:
        even_count += 1
    else:
        odd_count += 1

diff_array.sort()
accumulated = 0
result_count = 0

for diff in diff_array:
    if diff + accumulated <= b:
        result_count += 1
        accumulated += diff

print(result_count)
</translated_code>
